	<div class="entry-header-inner section-inner medium">

		<h1 class="entry-title">Prices the Villa in Punta Trettu Sardinia</h1>
	</div>

</header>

	<div class="post-inner thin ">

		<div class="entry-content">

			
<div class="wp-block-cover alignwide is-position-center-center" style="min-height:375px;aspect-ratio:unset;"><img decoding="async" class="wp-block-cover__image-background wp-image-6897 size-full" alt="" src="https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Punta-Trettu-Kitesurf-House-Sardegna.jpg" data-object-fit="cover"/><span aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-cover__background has-primary-background-color has-background-dim-30 has-background-dim"></span><div class="wp-block-cover__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-cover-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center" id="villa">🏠 Exclusive Villa: Your Ultimate HQ in Punta Trettu</h2>
</div></div>



<p>Are you looking to experience Punta Trettu in Sardinia with your group of friends, your kite team, or your family in total privacy? We offer the possibility of <strong>booking an entire villa for your exclusive use.</strong></p>



<p>Imagine waking up with your crew, having breakfast together while checking the wind from the garden, and walking straight to the spot. No strangers—just your people and the freedom to manage your own space.</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Kite &amp; Stay Early-Bird Special 🌬️</h3>



<p>Book your Villa and Kite Course combo at least 10 days in advance and enjoy a 10% discount on your villa stay! *</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Why choose the Exclusive Villa Rental?</h3>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Total Privacy &amp; Space:</strong> You will have the entire facility at your disposal, including modern rooms—each with a <strong>private bathroom</strong> and <strong>independent outdoor entrance</strong>—and all common areas.</li>



<li><strong>Built for Groups:</strong> Access to a fully equipped kitchen and spacious living areas where you can cook together, review the day&#8217;s kite videos, and plan your next session.</li>



<li><strong>Your Private Oasis:</strong> Enjoy the swimming pool, BBQ area, and relaxation zones without sharing them with other guests. It is the perfect setting for your Sardinian sunsets.</li>



<li><strong>Unbeatable Location:</strong> You are literally on the spot. Monitor the wind conditions from the garden and be on the water in less than two minutes.</li>
</ul>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Perfect for:</h3>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Kite Camps &amp; Schools:</strong> The ideal home base to host students in a professional and comfortable environment.</li>



<li><strong>Groups of Friends:</strong> For those who want to combine world-class sport with the fun of a shared holiday.</li>



<li><strong>Families:</strong> Enjoy the kitesurfing action while ensuring your loved ones have maximum comfort and tranquility.</li>
</ul>



<div class="wp-block-buttons is-layout-flex wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-button has-custom-width wp-block-button__width-100"><a class="wp-block-button__link wp-element-button" href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf9oeXgILcFKDw7O9tjlvbbE8J6jMA9sK2z-dvKMTPyHBRMcQ/viewform?usp=sf_link">Book your VILLA now</a></div>
</div>



<p><strong>Low season</strong> (September-June)</p>

<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>🚗<strong>Car for the movements</strong>: Punta Trettu &nbsp;is a wild area, where there are few services. For this it is highly recommended to have a bike, a car or a moppet (scooter) to be able to move if desired.</li>



<li>📜 Rules of Villa are&nbsp;<a href="https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/welcome/">here</a>.</li>



<li><strong>Deposit for the Villa rental</strong> (this measure has become necessary due to past incidents of rule violations by some guests): For the rental fo the Villa is required to leave <strong>a security deposit</strong>, which will be <strong>refunded at check-out</strong>, provided that:
<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>the Villa is left in a <strong>decent and tidy condition</strong>,</li>



<li><strong>no unauthorized or non-included services</strong> have been used,</li>



<li><strong>waste has been properly sorted and disposed of</strong> according to the provided guidelines.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>



<p><strong>Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.</strong></p>



<p></p>



<div class="wp-block-buttons is-layout-flex wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">

</div>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">* <em>&#8220;Stay &amp; Kite&#8221; 10% Discount — Conditions</em></h2>



<p>The 10% discount on your stay is reserved for bookings in which <em>all guests included in the reservation</em> attend a 10 h kite course with our partner school, and is <em>subject to actual course availability</em> for the requested dates.</p>



<p>The discount is not automatic: it must be requested before the booking is confirmed and applies only once confirmed by us in writing and te kite course is attended.</p>



<p>If even one guest does not enrol, withdraws, or fails to attend the course, the discount lapses and the full rate applies.</p>



<p>Lessons may be rescheduled or suspended due to weather, wind, or safety conditions. These circumstances are beyond our control and give no right to refunds or reductions on the accommodation.</p>



<p>The discount cannot be combined with other offers, promotions, or discount codes. It is not retroactive and has no cash value.</p>



<p>We reserve the right to amend or withdraw this promotion at any time. Changes do not affect bookings already confirmed in writing.</p>
